[[File:Security Module New.png|right]]The '''Secuity Module''' is a Defense Module that grants and enhances Armor Buffs.

==Description==
''The Security Module generates Armor Buffs for your Base Defenders as a defense mechanism. It was manufactured after a malfunction with an image-decompression protocom ray.''

==Max Stats==

* 1-Star
** Health: 257
** Attack: 17
** Rating: 39
* 2-Star
** Health: 536
** Attack: 34
** Rating: 97
* 3-Star
** Health: 3,258
** Attack: 206
** Rating: 558 (sig 50)
* 4-Star (Rank 3)
** Health: 7,002
** Attack: 442
** Rating: 1,093 (sig 10)

==Abilities==

=== Basic Abilities ===
* Armor
* [[Armor Buff]]
* Extended Armor Buffs
* Purification

=== Abilities ===
*''Passive:''
**+6~26 Armor Rating.
**Armor Buffs last 12~50% longer.
**Purify 1 [[Armor Break]] debuff[s] whenever an Armor Buff activates.
*''When Attacked:''
**8.4~9.6% chance to gain an Armor Buff if no other Armor Buffs are active, reducing damage from Attacks by 12~18% for 4 seconds.

==Strategy==

=== Base Defense ===
This Module is useful for reducing damage for bots with a low health rating, and for enhancing Bots with their own Armor Buffs. The Mod's signature ability is also effective against the Nullifys of [[Starscream]] and [[Ultra Magnus]].
* [[Grindor]]
* [[Optimus Prime (MV1)]]
* [[Bludgeon]]
* [[Optimus Primal]]
* [[Ramjet]]
*[[Optimus Prime]]
* [[Hound]]
* [[Ironhide]]

=== Raids ===
Though Armor Breaks may remove Armor Buffs, they can be purified, especially permanent Armor Breaks. Bots with Armor Piercing and damaging debuff Attacks are a good alternative for breaking through a Security Module.
* [[Windblade]]
* [[Shockwave]]
*[[Tactician|Tacticians]]
*[[Motormaster]] 
*[[Grimlock]]
*[[Megatronus]]
*[[Galvatron]]
